notes: Spec asserts: ready → working, state stays working across all retry cycles (no flicker to ready or waiting between attempts), final working → ready. The recipe drives a deterministic failing-then-corrective bash sequence (`false` then `echo recovered`) in ONE turn: the parser sees one user.message (working), a failing tool.execution_start/complete pair (data.success:false → IsError, NO state effect), any between-attempts assistant.message (never settles the turn — parser.go:187-188), the corrective pair, then assistant.turn_end (the ONLY ready settle). Because copilot's turn boundary is an EXPLICIT marker, no idle/settle heuristic runs, so a long pause between attempts cannot be mistaken for turn completion. `waiting` is reachable only via permission_requested and the driver launches with --allow-all, so it is structurally unreachable. The intermediate_working phase pins the no-flicker invariant with duration_at_least_ms 2000 — long enough to span both tool cycles at typical copilot latency; it fires if the parser ever surfaces a failed tool result as a transition to ready or waiting. PRESESSION BIRTH: copilot creates its session-state directory at launch but writes events.jsonl only when the first prompt is sent (driver SEAM 3), so processlifecycle emits a transient proc-<PID> row first (scanner.go:347) and the real dir-keyed session id arrives later — modelled as two phases with every later phase anchored same_session_as session_birth, templated from the mistral-vibe sibling for this scenario. The phase DSL has no tool-event form, so the retry loop is asserted through the single uninterrupted working span it sustains plus the two negative invariants. OBSERVATIONS: cost/tokens are asserted non-zero and ARE derivable from the staged transcript offline (assistant.message.outputTokens is copilot's live token signal; gpt-5-mini and claude-haiku-4-5 are both priced in the committed replay capacity snapshot). model is deliberately unpinned — --model accepts only 'auto' on this account and the router picks per turn between gpt-5-mini and claude-haiku-4.5, both observed in one live 1.0.77 session; record fills it from the recording.
